fusions.name: Quick Trample
fusions.desc: A stamping blow that deals 8 damage, up to 1.5 times as much at its maximum range of 5 tiles. It holds 4 charges, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Startling Stamp
fusions.desc: A thunderous stamp that deals 12 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and stuns them for 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Rind Lure
fusions.desc: A challenge that pulls up to 4 enemies within 6 tiles onto you for 6 seconds. While it lasts, a pack of mice fights beside you for 5 seconds, striking for 3 every 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Scurry Clear
fusions.desc: When you are hurt, you gain a ward that soaks 20% of your maximum health for 6 seconds. Once every 15 seconds.
